bugs.text: enterPlay sets state 'play' then scheduleRespawn overwrites it with 'respawn'. spawnPlayer never restores 'play', so once the timer reaches 0 the respawn branch calls spawnPlayer every tick, decrementing lives each time (3,2,1,0,-1) and calling gameOver within four ticks. The game goes READY -> GAME OVER with 0 shots fired and no enemies ever appear (screenshots 4-play-030s, 4-play-045s, 5-end). Nothing in the play state is reachable.

hitPlayer sets p.dying and p.dieT but nothing decrements the player's dieT or schedules a respawn (updateFx only handles enemies); a player death would soft-lock the game with dives disabled (458-459).
G.beams is never pushed to anywhere, so the tractor beam, capture, rescue, dual fighter and captive fire can never happen.

Formation layout is wrong: slotPos uses cx + slotCol*(1+br) with no column spacing, so all 16 columns fit in 16 px right of centre; bosses are placed on rows 0-3 and there are 18 goei and 18 zako instead of 16 and 20.

Challenging stage could never end: loop-path divers re-dive forever and are never removed; chHits/chWave are never incremented; state 'challengeEnd' has no update branch so it falls through to the play update and re-adds the bonus every tick.

Enter does not start the game: keydown Enter only sets fireLatch, while the title branch needs keys.fire, which only Space or a pointer click sets. Screenshots 2-after-enter-5s and 3-after-enter-8s still show the title. Same for the game-over return to title (399) despite the PRESS ENTER prompt (777).
makeSprite looks up COL[k] with single-letter keys ('y','b','r','g','w','c') but COL uses full names, so every sprite renders solid white (visible on the title screen).
No 2-frame wing animation: flapPhase is advanced but drawEnemy has one image per type.
Boss colour change after the first hit is a no-op (draws the same sprite; comment admits it).
Stage badges are reserve+1 copies of one tier with an empty label for stages 1-4, not the arcade's 1/5/10/20/30/50 breakdown of the stage number.
Lives and reserve are separate counters; the reserve ship display never decreases when a ship is spent.
Dive aggression does not rise with stage: 'base' is computed and unused, and the post-dive timer rand(3,7)+stage*0.2 grows with stage.
A diver that finishes its path snaps straight back to its slot instead of re-entering from the top.
Boss first hit awards 50 points (not in the spec); destroying a boss in formation with a captive frees the captive instead of destroying it.
S.enemyHit is defined but never called.

summary: The file is well organised on the surface (a G state object, a fixed-timestep loop, separate update and draw, sprite and font data, synthesized Web Audio) and the title screen, STAGE 1 card, READY and the game-over results screen all render. But the game cannot be played: enterPlay immediately hands off to a respawn state that spawnPlayer never leaves, so the respawn branch re-spawns every tick, burns all lives and reaches GAME OVER within a fraction of a second with 0 shots fired, and no enemy ever appears. Everything behind that (entry paths, dives, escorts, scoring, collisions, explosions, stage clear) is dead code, and much of it is wrong anyway: the formation has no column spacing and the wrong row counts, the tractor beam is never created so the signature capture/dual-fighter mechanic is absent, sprites all render white because the palette keys do not match, there is no wing animation, Enter does not start the game, player death is never resolved, and the challenging stage could never finish. As Galaga it is a title screen and a results screen; faithfulness to the arcade is limited to the HUD text and score table.
